scope: Actual final encoded 2560x1440 MP4, independently decoded and visually inspected at the stated frames. Illustrative scientific model visualization; no navigation-safety claim.

visual_assessment.full_map: Inspected all nine decoded whole-map frames and a native full-frame decode at frame360. Temperature pattern and current-trail orientation evolve substantially through the chronological week. Early western/central salmon and orange, cooler north-shore blues, and later cyan/green expansion remain distinct and readable. No new broad blank band or repeated angular mesh teeth appears.
visual_assessment.middle_lake: Inspected native-resolution crops around the former anomaly in all nine frames. The current pattern changes direction and curvature through the week; the artificial repeated triangular boundaries are absent. Broad curved shear and locally weak/reversing lanes remain visible rather than being removed wholesale.
visual_assessment.carleton_and_upstream_handoff: Inspected the native-source crop spanning76.62W to76.15W,44.04N to44.27N at seven chronological phases and two replay phases, enlarged by nearest-neighbor scaling for visibility. Main Carleton channels keep bright grey trails, colored lake flow reaches the independent river support, and no new broad cross-channel black break is visible. Black islands remain land; the sharp thermal-to-grey boundary denotes missing temperature rather than a deliberately blank current field.
visual_assessment.clock: The actual clock raster matches the expected times12Oct00:00,13Oct04:00,14Oct08:00,15Oct12:00,16Oct16:00,17Oct20:00 and18Oct23:46UTC. The renderer uses the closing19Oct00 sample for interpolation but does not claim to display that exact endpoint.
visual_assessment.replay: Frame735 clearly reads REPLAY - WEEK RESTARTS over the editorial image dissolve. Frame749 returns to the12Oct00:00 initial clock and initial thermal/trail state. No interpolated last-to-first weather state is claimed.
visual_assessment.footer_and_legend: Inspected native-pixel decoded footer crops at frames0 and600. Both show readable <=12,13,14,15,>=16.5 and degreesC; hourly12-18October lake source dates; grey/unavailable and enhanced river motion explanation; simplified unvalidated depth-averaged estimate disclaimer; and separate fixed12-17October/not-hourly river forcing. The original Unicode capped labels, en dashes, middle dots and degree symbol render correctly, without mojibake or overlapping ticks.
visual_assessment.remaining_scientific_limits: Lake fields are hourly model nowcasts with linear display interpolation, not current observations or a diagnosed seiche. The river is an independently estimated constant mean-forcing scenario and is not physically coupled to the evolving lake at matching transient transport. Display reconstruction and enhanced river trails do not establish local jet, eddy, transport or navigational accuracy.
visual_assessment.verdict: Accept this exact encoded file for the requested chronological colored loop. No blocking visual or scientific-label issue found in the inspected frames. Numerical integration, motion and seam checks are covered separately by the main and solver lanes.
